lines.text:
Team Rocket will do anything for the sake
of money!\c
There is no job too dirty, no deed too heinous,
no crime too wicked!

I saw Cubone’s mother trying to escape from
Team Rocket.\c
But she got caught...\c
I was so scared that I couldn’t even go to try to
save her.
You know how Cubone wear skulls, right?\c\nFrom what I’ve heard, it seems people will pay\na lot for one of those skulls.
A flyer is stuck between the magazines...

“A word of gratitude from the Pokémon House!
Two of our Pokémon were able to meet new
Trainers and be adopted last month.\c
“Our thanks to everyone in the community who
helped make this possible!\c
“We apologize for the noise the Pokémon make
every day, but we hope you will
all continue supporting the Pokémon House.”
